title: Plan-scoped one-sided counter-line verification (PCV): feasibility measurement

rationale.problem: Production search completes at most D2 under a 100ms main budget; it has no tactical proof capability. Root-level quantified proofs cost 46 nodes/1ms to 600k nodes/20s on the frozen sample and cannot be an online root layer.
rationale.hypothesis: A quantifier restricted to the post-plan frontier (cat first turn fixed as the executed plan) can produce a verified decisive result (mouse forced win, or cat survival within H1) within a small reserved budget on a meaningful fraction of the 48 frozen combinations.
rationale.nonGoal: This round does not choose a better plan, does not change the 100ms/150ms budgets, does not wire anything into production, and does not claim general superiority.

frozenInputs.head: 48eaac6c4f3801d351787696ba5876995b64e8d8
frozenInputs.worktreePolicy: Use the current local worktree; never substitute a remote HEAD for the local uncommitted candidate.

productionResults.note: Use the recorded finalPlan and timing fields; do not rerun the main search in this round.

sidecar.note: Unchanged. This round only measures a separate offline channel; it does not modify or re-tune the sidecar.

replay.engine: real rules (catMove/catPlaceTrap/endTurn boundary) with deterministic checks
assertions: every action must be accepted by the real engine
the replayed cat turn must end exactly once
the 5 recorded rounds of a combination must agree on finalPlan; if not, mark the combination INCONSISTENT and exclude it from strong coverage
replay.boundaryPolicy: If the CAT->MOUSE boundary has pending ghosts or placement debt, the replay is CONDITIONAL_BOUNDARY: the frontier depends on a random outcome. Such a result may be recorded but must not be counted as an unconditional pre-decision proof.

modes.name: mouseForce_H0
modes.meaning: Can the mouse force a win within its complete next turn? (one actor switch from the frontier)

modes.name: catSurvive_H0
modes.meaning: Can the cat avoid MouseWins for the mouse's complete next turn? Weak guarantee.

modes.name: catSurvive_H1
modes.meaning: Can the cat avoid MouseWins across mouse+cat+mouse? Stronger guarantee; optional, only if budget allows.

forbidden: reporting a cap-hit or null result as PROVEN
using Math.random anywhere in the search
hardcoding expected classifications or node counts
frontierQuantifier.verification: Every PROVEN result must be re-checked by the independent verifier (re-enumerate all opponent actions and all positive-probability chance outcomes; policy must be complete). Any policy miss invalidates the result.

repetitions.execution: serial, single worker, fresh state per repetition, deterministic seeds not required (search is chance-enumerative)

budgetModel.availableSlackFormula: 150 - recordedTurnWallMs - safetyMarginMs; if recordedTurnWallMs is unavailable, use 150 - recordedMainElapsedMs - recordedPostSearchElapsedMs - safetyMarginMs and record which formula was used
budgetModel.note: The recorded times come from P5. Where the recorded turn already exceeded 150ms, availableSlack is <= 0 and PCV could not run in production without an explicit budget reallocation.

escalation.condition: Only if phase1 strong coverage is below the gate AND availableSlack >= wallCapMs on at least 75% of combinations.
escalation.note: Escalation is a single preregistered step; no further budget increases are allowed in this round.

outcomeTaxonomy.REFUTED: mouseForce_H0 returned true, cap not hit, independent verifier PROVEN, plan prefix and post-prefix stateKey bound. TACTICAL_PROOF of a mouse forced win within one mouse turn.
outcomeTaxonomy.SURVIVES_WITHIN_H0: catSurvive_H0 returned true, cap not hit, independent verifier PROVEN. TACTICAL_PROOF but weak (one mouse turn only).
outcomeTaxonomy.SURVIVES_WITHIN_H1: catSurvive_H1 returned true, cap not hit, independent verifier PROVEN. TACTICAL_PROOF within H1; stronger but optional.
outcomeTaxonomy.UNKNOWN: false, null, cap hit, deadline hit, verifier failure, or policy miss. Never safe.
outcomeTaxonomy.CONDITIONAL_BOUNDARY: The frontier depended on a stochastic CAT->MOUSE boundary outcome. Recorded, but excluded from unconditional strong coverage.
outcomeTaxonomy.INCONSISTENT: The 5 recorded finalPlan strings disagree or the replay fails. Excluded from all coverage counts and reported separately.

G0_identity.requirement: fixture SHA, rules SHA, quantifier kernel SHA, branch and HEAD unchanged; replay stateKey recorded for every combination.
G0_identity.onFailure: STOP; report identity mismatch; do not proceed.

G1_zero_false_proofs.requirement: Every PROVEN result independently verified with 0 policy misses; 0 cap-hit results labeled PROVEN; 0 catSurvive derived from !mouseForce.
G1_zero_false_proofs.onFailure: Invalidate the affected results and STOP the round; report as a soundness failure.

G2_strong_coverage.requirement: At least 12 of 48 combinations produce REFUTED or SURVIVES_WITHIN_H1 under the phase1 caps, excluding CONDITIONAL_BOUNDARY and INCONSISTENT combinations.
G2_strong_coverage.onFailure: PCV-NO-GO for production wiring. Escalation is allowed only under the preregistered escalation condition; if still below 12, the round ends NO-GO.

G3_budget_feasibility.requirement: At least 75% of combinations have availableSlack >= the phase1 wallCapMs (20ms), and no combination requires more than the single escalation cap (40ms) to be decisive.
G3_budget_feasibility.onFailure: AMBER: PCV may only be used offline/shadow; no wiring without an explicit budget reallocation decision.

G4_no_plan_change.requirement: In shadow mode, 0 plan changes; PCV never overrides the baseline plan in this round.
G4_no_plan_change.onFailure: Invalidate the round; this is a wiring violation.

G5_binding.requirement: Every result record includes plan string, post-prefix stateKey, H, mode, cap, truncated flag, node count, chance node count, elapsed ms, verifier verdict, and certificate hash.
G5_binding.onFailure: The affected result is UNKNOWN; a proof without a binding is not a proof.

G6_no_upgrade.requirement: NO_REFUTATION_FOUND, INCOMPLETE, CHANCE_MIXED, UNRESOLVED, and cap hits never appear in a PROOF field.
G6_no_upgrade.onFailure: Invalidate the round; report as a taxonomy violation.

decisionMatrix.GREEN: G0+G1+G2+G3+G4+G5+G6 pass: propose an integration design for a later round; still no production wiring in this round.
decisionMatrix.AMBER: G0+G1+G2+G4+G5+G6 pass but G3 fails: PCV is offline/shadow only; wiring requires a future budget reallocation decision.
decisionMatrix.RED: G2 fails after the single escalation: PCV-NO-GO.
decisionMatrix.INVALID: Any G0/G1/G4/G5/G6 failure: the round's results are not usable; stop and report.

killCriteria: Any PROVEN result failing independent verification.
Any cap-hit or null result written into a PROOF field.
Any use of !mouseForce as a cat survival proof.
Any plan/stateKey mismatch between the proof and the replayed plan.
Any change to game rules, search math, sidecar, guard, H1, or 100ms/150ms budgets.
Any parallel heavy worker or self-play.
Any hardcoded expected classification or node count.

resourcePlan.expectedRuntime: Bounded: 48 replays + at most 720 phase1 PCV runs (3 modes x 5 repetitions x 48 frontiers) at <=20ms each, plus overhead; H1 is skipped when the wall budget is exhausted. No main-search rerun. If any single run exceeds its wall cap by more than 2x, abort that run and record a timeout, do not retry in a loop.

successCriteria.scientific: Measure the real cost and decisive-result distribution of plan-scoped PCV under a frozen, preregistered protocol; report counts, not significance claims.
successCriteria.engineering: Determine whether a verified, plan-bound tactical result can be produced inside the existing 150ms envelope without changing the main search.
successCriteria.honesty: No false proof, no UNRESOLVED-as-safe, no signal-to-proof upgrade, no production wiring in this round.

limitations: 24 roots x 2 arms is a frozen sample, not a population inference.
H0 cat survival is a weak guarantee (one mouse turn).
H1 proofs may be too expensive for a small reserved budget; the measurement is designed to find that out, not to force a positive result.
A stochastic CAT->MOUSE boundary makes the frontier conditional; the first prototype does not include boundary CHANCE inside the quantifier.
PCV verifies only the executed plan (and at most two equal-primary alternatives in a later round); it does not verify the root's full action set.

nextRoundIfGreen.note: Produce an integration design and a new preregistration. No production code changes without a separate authorization.

nextRoundIfAmber.note: Keep PCV offline; do not wire. Optionally measure whether trimming the sidecar can free the required slack, without changing production in this round.

nextRoundIfRed.note: PCV-NO-GO. Do not escalate budget again; return to architecture options.
